translations.idiomatic: Editors, revisers, and archivists, together with the left palace direct counselor, orthographer, and reading supporter of the left eastern palace, were ordered to review memorials from the various offices; if approved, they signed as "Such-and-such official of the Hanlin Academy, concurrently reviewing documents of the various offices," and listed their names.

sentences.zh: 十八年，更定品員，如前所列，獨未有庶起士。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year ranks and quotas were redefined as listed above; only palace graduates had not yet been established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year ranks and quotas were redefined as listed above, but palace graduates had not yet been established.

sentences.zh: 以侍讀先侍講。

translations.literal: The reader was placed before the expositor.
translations.idiomatic: The reader was ranked above the expositor.

sentences.zh: 建文時，仍設承旨，改侍讀、侍講兩學士為文學博士，設文翰、文史二館，文翰以居侍讀、侍講、侍書、《五經》博士、典籍、待詔，文史以居修撰、編修、檢討。

translations.literal: In the Jianwen period the Proclaimer was again established; the two reader-in-chief and expositor-in-chief lecturers were changed into literary doctors; the Literary Composition and Literary History halls were established — the former housed readers, expositors, attendant scribes, doctors of the Five Classics, archivists, and awaiting edict officers, the latter housed compilers, editors, and revisers.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jianwen emperor the proclaimer was restored; the reader-in-chief and expositor-in-chief lecturers were renamed literary doctors; and the Literary Composition and Literary History halls were established — the former housing readers, expositors, attendant scribes, doctors of the Five Classics, archivists, and awaiting edict officers, the latter housing compilers, editors, and revisers.

sentences.zh: 改孔目為典簿，改中書舍人為侍書，以隸翰林。

translations.literal: The registrar was changed into a directorate assistant, and secretariat drafters were changed into attendant scribes, subordinated to the Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar was renamed directorate assistant, and secretariat drafters were renamed attendant scribes and placed under the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 又設文淵閣待詔及拾遺、補闕等官。

translations.literal: Awaiting edict officers of the Wenyuan Pavilion were also established, as well as omission-picker and gap-filler and other such offices.
translations.idiomatic: Awaiting edict officers of the Wenyuan Pavilion were also established, along with omission-picker, gap-filler, and other such offices.

sentences.zh: 成祖初復舊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Chengzu reign the old system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chengzu's reign the old system was restored.

sentences.zh: 其年九月，特簡講、讀、編、檢等官參預機務，簡用無定員。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of that year expositor, reader, editor, reviser, and other officials were specially selected to take part in confidential state affairs; the number selected had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of that year expositors, readers, editors, revisers, and other officials were specially selected to take part in confidential state affairs, without fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 謂之內閣。

translations.literal: This was called the Inner Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: This body was called the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 然解縉、胡廣等既直文淵閣，猶相繼署院事。

translations.literal: Yet although Xie Jin, Hu Guang, and others were on duty at the Wenyuan Pavilion, they still continued in succession to sign academy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yet although Xie Jin, Hu Guang, and others served at the Wenyuan Pavilion, they still continued in turn to sign Hanlin Academy business.

sentences.zh: 至洪熙以後，楊士奇等加至師保，禮絕百僚，始不復署。

translations.literal: By the time of the Hongxi reign and after, when Yang Shiqi and others were advanced to tutor and guardian ranks and their ritual precedence surpassed all officials, they ceased signing again.
translations.idiomatic: After Hongxi, when Yang Shiqi and others were advanced to tutor and guardian ranks and took ritual precedence over all officials, they ceased signing.

sentences.zh: 正統七年，翰林院落成，學士錢習禮不設楊士奇、楊溥公座，曰：「此非三公府也」，二楊以聞。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of the Zhengtong reign, when the Hanlin Academy building was completed, Academician Qian Xili did not set out public seats for Yang Shiqi and Yang Pu, saying, "This is not the office of the Three Dukes"; the two Yangs reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhengtong, when the Hanlin Academy building was completed, Academician Qian Xili did not set out seats of honor for Yang Shiqi and Yang Pu, saying, "This is not the office of the Three Dukes"; the two Yangs reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 乃命工部具椅案，禮部定位次，以內閣固翰林職也。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Ministry of Works was ordered to supply chairs and tables, and the Ministry of Rites to fix seating order, on the grounds that the Inner Secretariat was after all a Hanlin post.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works was then ordered to supply chairs and tables, and the Ministry of Rites to fix seating order, on the grounds that the Inner Secretariat was after all a Hanlin office.

sentences.zh: 嘉、隆以前，文移關白，猶稱翰林院，以後則竟稱內閣矣。

translations.literal: Before the Jiajing and Longqing reigns, in documents and communications it was still called the Hanlin Academy; afterward it was simply called the Inner Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jiajing and Longqing, official documents still referred to the Hanlin Academy; afterward they referred simply to the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 其在六部，自成化時，周洪謨以後，禮部尚書、侍郎必由翰林，吏部兩侍郎必有一由於翰林。

translations.literal: As for the six ministries, from the Chenghua period onward, after Zhou Hongmo the minister and vice ministers of rites had to come from the Hanlin, and of the two vice ministers of personnel one had to come from the Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: In the six ministries, from Chenghua onward, after Zhou Hongmo the minister and vice ministers of rites had to come from the Hanlin, and one of the two vice ministers of personnel had to come from the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 其由翰林者，尚書則兼學士，六部皆然。

translations.literal: Those who came from the Hanlin, if ministers, concurrently held academician rank — this was true of all six ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers drawn from the Hanlin concurrently held academician rank — this was true of all six ministries.

sentences.zh: 侍郎則兼侍讀、侍講學士。

translations.literal: Vice ministers concurrently held reader-in-chief or expositor-in-chief lecturer rank.
translations.idiomatic: Vice ministers concurrently held reader-in-chief or expositor-in-chief lecturer rank.

sentences.zh: 其在詹事府暨坊、局官，視其品級，必帶本院銜。

translations.literal: For those in the Grand Secretariat of the Heir Apparent and in the eastern-palace and classics-bureau offices, according to their rank they had to carry titles of their own academy.
translations.idiomatic: For the Grand Secretariat of the Heir Apparent and its eastern-palace and classics-bureau offices, according to rank they had to carry Hanlin titles.

sentences.zh: 詹事、少詹事帶學士銜，春坊大學士不常設，庶子、諭德、中允、贊善、洗馬等則帶講、讀學士以下至編、檢銜。

translations.literal: The grand mentor and deputy grand mentor carried academician titles; the eastern palace chief instructor was not regularly established; household vice prefects, preceptors, palace rectifiers, palace supporters, readers-in-waiting, and the like carried expositor-in-chief and reader-in-chief lecturer titles down to editor and reviser titles.
translations.idiomatic: The grand mentor and deputy grand mentor carried academician titles; the eastern palace chief instructor was not regularly filled; household vice prefects, preceptors, palace rectifiers, palace supporters, and readers-in-waiting carried expositor-in-chief and reader-in-chief lecturer titles down to editor and reviser titles.

sentences.zh: 史官，自洪武十四年置修撰三人，編修、檢討各四人。

translations.literal: Historiographical officers: from the fourteenth year of Hongwu three compilers were established, and four editors and four revisers each.
translations.idiomatic: Historiographical officers: from the fourteenth year of Hongwu three compilers were established, with four editors and four revisers each.

sentences.zh: 其後由一甲進士除授及庶起士留館授職，往往溢額，無定員。

translations.literal: Thereafter, through direct appointment of first-rank jinshi graduates and palace graduates retained in the academy and granted posts, the quota was often exceeded, and there was no fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, through appointment of top-ranked jinshi graduates and palace graduates retained in the academy, the quota was often exceeded and there was no fixed number.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年，復定講、讀、修撰各三人，編修、檢討各六人，皆從吏部推補，如諸司例。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiajing, quotas were again fixed at three each for expositors, readers, and compilers, and six each for editors and revisers, all to be nominated and filled by the Ministry of Personnel according to the precedent of the various ministries.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiajing, quotas were again fixed at three expositors, three readers, three compilers, six editors, and six revisers, all nominated and filled by the Ministry of Personnel as with other ministries.

sentences.zh: 然未幾即以侍從人少，詔採方正有學術者以充其選，因改御史胡經、員外郎陳束、主事唐順之等七人俱為編修。

translations.literal: Yet before long, because attendants at court were few, an edict ordered the recruitment of upright and worthy men of learning to fill the selection; accordingly the seven men Supervising Censor Hu Jing, Vice Director Chen Shu, Section Chief Tang Shunzhi, and others were all changed to editors.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because court attendants were few, an edict ordered recruitment of upright and learned men to fill the ranks; Supervising Censor Hu Jing, Vice Director Chen Shu, Section Chief Tang Shunzhi, and four others were all appointed editors.

sentences.zh: 以後仍循舊例，由庶起士除授，卒無定額。

translations.literal: Thereafter the old practice was still followed, with appointment through palace graduates, and in the end there was no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the old practice continued, with appointment through palace graduates, and in the end there was no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 崇禎七年，又考選推官、知縣為編修、檢討，蓋亦創舉，非常制也。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongzhen, pushing officials and county magistrates were again selected by examination for appointment as editors and revisers — this too was an innovation, not the regular system.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Chongzhen, pushing officials and county magistrates were again examined and selected as editors and revisers — an innovation, not the regular system.

sentences.zh: 庶起士，自洪武初有六科庶起士。

translations.literal: Palace graduates: from the beginning of Hongwu there were palace graduates in the six offices.
translations.idiomatic: Palace graduates: from the beginning of Hongwu there were palace graduates in the six offices.

sentences.zh: 十八年以進士在翰林院、承敕監等近侍者，俱稱庶起士。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, jinshi who were close attendants in the Hanlin Academy, the Document Issuance Directorate, and the like were all called palace graduates.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, jinshi serving as close attendants in the Hanlin Academy, the Document Issuance Directorate, and the like were all called palace graduates.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，始定為翰林院庶起士，選進士文學優等及善書者為之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle, they were first fixed as Hanlin Academy palace graduates, selected from jinshi of superior literary attainment and those skilled in calligraphy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongle, Hanlin Academy palace graduates were first established, chosen from jinshi of superior literary attainment and those skilled in calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 三年試之。

translations.literal: After three years they were tested.
translations.idiomatic: After three years they were examined.

sentences.zh: 其留者，二甲授編修，三甲授檢討；

translations.literal: Those retained were granted editor rank in the second class and reviser rank in the third class;
translations.idiomatic: Those retained received editor rank in the second class and reviser rank in the third class;

sentences.zh: 不得留者，則為給事中、御史，或出為州縣官。

translations.literal: those not retained became supervising secretaries or censors, or were sent out as prefectural and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: those not retained became supervising secretaries or censors, or were sent out as prefectural and county officials.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，始命學士教習。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande, academicians were first ordered to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande, academicians were first ordered to instruct them.

sentences.zh: 萬曆以後，掌教習者，專以吏、禮二部侍郎二人。

translations.literal: After Wanli, those in charge of instruction were exclusively the two vice ministers of the Ministries of Personnel and Rites.
translations.idiomatic: After Wanli, instruction was entrusted exclusively to the two vice ministers of the Ministries of Personnel and Rites.

sentences.zh: 明初，嘗置弘文館學士，洪武三年置，以胡鉉為學士，又命劉基、危素、王本中、睢稼皆兼弘文館學士，未幾罷。

translations.literal: In the early Ming, Hongwen Hall academicians were once established — in the third year of Hongwu they were set up, with Hu Qian as academician; Liu Ji, Wei Su, Wang Benzhong, and Suai Jia were also all ordered to hold concurrent posts as Hongwen Hall academicians; before long they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Ming, Hongwen Hall academicians were once established — in the third year of Hongwu Hu Qian was appointed academician, and Liu Ji, Wei Su, Wang Benzhong, and Song Lian were all ordered to serve concurrently as Hongwen Hall academicians; before long the office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 宣德間，復建弘文閣於思善門右，以翰林學士楊溥掌閣印，尋併入文淵閣。

translations.literal: In the Xuande period, Hongwen Pavilion was rebuilt on the right of the Sishan Gate, with Hanlin Academician Yang Pu in charge of the pavilion seal; soon it was merged into the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuande period, Hongwen Pavilion was rebuilt to the right of the Sishan Gate, with Hanlin Academician Yang Pu in charge of the pavilion seal; soon it was merged into the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 祕書監，洪武三年置，秩正六品，除監丞一人，直長二人，尋定設令一人，丞、直長各二人，掌內府書籍。

translations.literal: The Secretariat Directorate was established in the third year of Hongwu, rank 6a; one assistant director and two chief clerks were appointed; soon it was fixed with one director, two vice directors, and two chief clerks each, in charge of the inner palace book collections.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat Directorate was established in the third year of Hongwu at rank 6a, with one assistant director and two chief clerks; soon one director, two vice directors, and two chief clerks were fixed, in charge of the inner palace book collections.

sentences.zh: 十三年併入翰林院典籍。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year it was merged into the Hanlin Academy archivist.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year it was merged into the Hanlin Academy archivist.

sentences.zh: 起居注，甲辰年置。

translations.literal: Diarist of Attendance, established in the jiachen year.
translations.idiomatic: Diarist of Attendance, established in the jiachen year.

sentences.zh: 吳元年定秩正五品。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wu the rank was fixed at 5a.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wu the rank was fixed at 5a.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年改正七品。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu changed to 7b.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Hongwu it was changed to 7b.

sentences.zh: 六年升從六品。

translations.literal: In the sixth year promoted to 6b.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year it was promoted to 6b.

sentences.zh: 九年定起居注二人，後革。

translations.literal: In the ninth year two diarists of attendance were fixed, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year two diarists of attendance were fixed, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 十四年復置，秩從七品，尋罷。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year restored, rank 7b, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the office was restored at rank 7b, soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 至萬曆間，命翰林院官兼攝之。

translations.literal: By the Wanli period, Hanlin Academy officials were ordered to hold the post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: By the Wanli period, Hanlin Academy officials were ordered to hold the post concurrently.

sentences.zh: 已復罷。

translations.literal: Soon abolished again.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it was abolished again.

sentences.zh: 尋皆罷。

translations.literal: Soon all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 國子監

translations.literal: Directorate of Education
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Education

sentences.zh: 國子監。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 祭酒一人。

translations.literal: One Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: One Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 從四品司業一人。

translations.literal: One Vice Chancellor, 6b.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Chancellor, rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 正六品其屬，繩愆廳，監丞一人，正八品博士廳，《五經》博士五人。

translations.literal: Subordinates, rank 6a: the Admonishment Office, one supervisor, 8a; the Doctoral Office, five doctors of the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates at rank 6a: the Admonishment Office with one supervisor at 8a; the Doctoral Office with five doctors of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 從八品率性、修道、誠心、正義、崇志、廣業六堂，助教十五人，從八品學正十人，正九品學錄七人。

translations.literal: Subordinates 8b: the six halls Following Nature, Cultivating the Way, Sincere Heart, Righteousness, Esteeming Aspiration, and Broad Endeavor — fifteen assistant instructors 8b, ten directors of study 9a, seven registrars 9b.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 8b: the six halls Following Nature, Cultivating the Way, Sincere Heart, Righteousness, Esteeming Aspiration, and Broad Endeavor — fifteen assistant instructors, ten directors of study at 9a, and seven registrars at 9b.

sentences.zh: 從九品典簿廳，典簿一人。

translations.literal: The Records Office, one registrar, 9b.
translations.idiomatic: The Records Office, one registrar at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 從八品典籍廳，典籍一人。

translations.literal: The Archivist Office, one archivist, 8b.
translations.idiomatic: The Archivist Office, one archivist at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 從九品掌饌廳，掌饌二人。

translations.literal: The Commissariat Office, two food administrators, 9b.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissariat Office, two food administrators at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 未入流

translations.literal: Outside the regular ranks
translations.idiomatic: Outside the regular ranks

sentences.zh: 祭酒、司業，掌國學諸生訓導之政令。

translations.literal: The Chancellor and Vice Chancellor directed the policies for instruction and guidance of students in the national academy.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor and Vice Chancellor directed instruction and guidance of students in the national academy.

sentences.zh: 凡舉人、貢生、官生、恩生、功生、例生、土官、外國生、幼勳臣及勳戚大臣子弟之入監者，奉監規而訓課之，造以明體達用之學，以孝弟、禮義、忠信、廉恥為之本，以六經、諸史為之業，務各期以敦倫善行，敬業樂羣，以修舉古樂正、成均之師道。

translations.literal: All presented scholars, tribute students, official students, grace students, merit students, purchased students, native officials, foreign students, young merit subjects, and sons of meritorious subjects and great ministers who entered the directorate were taught under its regulations, molded in learning that clarifies substance and applies it usefully, with filial piety and fraternal duty, ritual and righteousness, loyalty and trustworthiness, and integrity and shame as the foundation, and the Six Classics and various histories as their occupation, each expected to cultivate moral conduct and good deeds, devote themselves to study and delight in fellowship, thereby upholding the teacher's way of the ancient Director of Music and the Director of the Grand Academy.
translations.idiomatic: All presented scholars, tribute students, official students, grace students, merit students, purchased students, native officials, foreign students, young merit subjects, and sons of meritorious subjects and great ministers who entered the directorate were taught under its regulations, molded in learning that clarifies principles and applies them in practice, with filial piety, ritual, loyalty, and integrity as the foundation and the Six Classics and histories as their studies, each expected to cultivate moral conduct, devote themselves to learning, and uphold the teaching tradition of the ancient Director of Music and Grand Academy.

sentences.zh: 有不率者，撲以夏楚，不悛，徙謫之。

translations.literal: Those who did not follow discipline were beaten with the summer rod; if unrepentant, they were transferred and demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Those who did not follow discipline were beaten with the summer rod; if unrepentant, they were transferred and demoted.

sentences.zh: 其率教者，有升堂積分超格敘用之法。

translations.literal: Those who followed instruction had methods of advancing halls, accumulating points, exceeding grades, and ordered appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Those who followed instruction could advance halls, accumulate points, exceed grades, and receive ordered appointment.

sentences.zh: 課業仿書，季呈翰林院考校，文冊歲終奏上。

translations.literal: Coursework and calligraphy models were submitted quarterly to the Hanlin Academy for examination; registers were presented at year's end.
translations.idiomatic: Coursework and calligraphy models were submitted quarterly to the Hanlin Academy for examination; registers were presented at year's end.

sentences.zh: 每歲仲春秋上丁，遣大臣祀先師，則總其禮儀。

translations.literal: Each year on the first ding day of the second and eighth months, when grand ministers were sent to sacrifice to the sage teacher, they oversaw the ritual observances.
translations.idiomatic: Each year on the first ding day of the second and eighth months, when grand ministers were sent to sacrifice to the sage teacher, they oversaw the ritual observances.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸學，則執經坐講。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage visited the academy, they held the classics and lectured seated.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited the academy, they held the classics and lectured seated.

sentences.zh: 新進士釋褐，則坐而受拜。

translations.literal: When new jinshi changed from mourning dress, they sat and received bows.
translations.idiomatic: When new jinshi changed from mourning dress, they sat and received bows.

sentences.zh: 監丞掌繩愆廳之事，以參領監務，堅明其約束，諸師生有過及廩膳不潔，並糾懲之，而書之於集愆冊。

translations.literal: The supervisor managed Admonishment Office affairs, assisted in overseeing directorate business, enforced regulations strictly; any offences by teachers and students or impure grain rations were investigated and punished, and recorded in the register of accumulated faults.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisor managed Admonishment Office affairs, assisted in overseeing directorate business, and enforced regulations; offences by teachers and students or impure grain rations were investigated and punished and recorded in the register of accumulated faults.

sentences.zh: 博士掌分經講授，而時其考課。

translations.literal: Doctors were in charge of lecture by classic division and scheduled their examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Doctors lectured by classic division and scheduled examinations.

sentences.zh: 凡經，以《易》、《詩》、《書》、《春秋》、《禮記》，人專一經，《大學》、《中庸》、《論語》、《孟子》兼習之。

translations.literal: For classics: Changes, Odes, Documents, Spring and Autumn, and Record of Rites — each person specialized in one classic; Great Learning, Doctrine of the Mean, Analects, and Mencius were studied jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The classics were the Changes, Odes, Documents, Spring and Autumn, and Record of Rites — each student specialized in one, while Great Learning, Doctrine of the Mean, Analects, and Mencius were studied jointly.

sentences.zh: 助教、學正、學錄掌六堂之訓誨，士子肄業本堂，則為講說經義文字，導約之以規矩。

translations.literal: Assistant instructors, directors of study, and registrars directed instruction in the six halls; when students pursued studies in their hall, they expounded classics and literary form and guided them with rules.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant instructors, directors of study, and registrars directed instruction in the six halls; when students studied in their hall, they expounded classics and literary form and guided them with rules.

sentences.zh: 典簿，典文移金錢出納支受。

translations.literal: The registrar managed documents, money receipts and disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar managed documents and money receipts and disbursements.

sentences.zh: 典籍，典書籍。

translations.literal: The archivist managed books.
translations.idiomatic: The archivist managed books.

sentences.zh: 掌饌，掌飲饌。

translations.literal: Food administrators managed drink and food.
translations.idiomatic: Food administrators managed drink and food.

sentences.zh: 明初，即置國子學。

translations.literal: In the early Ming, the National Academy was immediately established.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Ming, the National Academy was established.

sentences.zh: 乙巳九月置國子學，以故集慶路學為之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of yisi, the National Academy was established, using the former Jiqing Road school for it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of yisi, the National Academy was established, using the former Jiqing Road school.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年，改建國子學於雞鳴山下。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, the National Academy was rebuilt at the foot of Jiming Hill.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, the National Academy was rebuilt at the foot of Jiming Hill.

sentences.zh: 設博士、助教、學正、學錄、典樂、典書、典膳等官。

translations.literal: Doctors, assistant instructors, directors of study, registrars, directors of music, directors of books, directors of provisions, and other offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: Doctors, assistant instructors, directors of study, registrars, directors of music, directors of books, directors of provisions, and other offices were established.

sentences.zh: 吳元年，定國子學官制，增設祭酒、司業、典簿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wu the national academy official system was fixed, adding Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wu the national academy official system was fixed, adding Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Registrar.

sentences.zh: 祭酒，正四品，司業，正五品，博士，正七品，典簿，正八品，助教，從八品，學正，正九品，學錄，從九品，典膳，省注。

translations.literal: Chancellor 4a, Vice Chancellor 5a, Doctor 7a, Registrar 8a, Assistant instructor 8b, Director of study 9a, Registrar 9b, Commissary — as noted in document.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor at 4a, Vice Chancellor at 5a, Doctor at 7a, Registrar at 8a, Assistant instructor at 8b, Director of study at 9a, Registrar at 9b, Commissary — as noted in document.

sentences.zh: 洪武八年，又置中都國子學，秩正四品命國子學分官領之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Hongwu, the Zhongdu National Academy was also established, rank 4a, with officials of the capital academy assigned to head it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Hongwu, the Zhongdu National Academy was also established at rank 4a, with officials of the capital academy assigned to head it.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改典膳為掌饌。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Commissary was changed to Food Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Commissary was changed to Food Administrator.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改為國子監，秩從四品，設祭酒一人，司業一人，監丞、典簿各一人，博士三人，助教十六人，學正、學錄各三人，掌饌一人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year changed to Directorate of Education, rank 6b, one Chancellor, one Vice Chancellor, one supervisor and registrar each, three doctors, sixteen assistant instructors, three each for director of study and registrar, one food administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year it was changed to the Directorate of Education at rank 6b, with one Chancellor, one Vice Chancellor, one supervisor and registrar each, three doctors, sixteen assistant instructors, three directors of study and three registrars, and one food administrator.

sentences.zh: 各官品秩，如前所列。

translations.literal: Each official's rank was as listed above.
translations.idiomatic: Each official's rank was as listed above.

sentences.zh: 中都國子監制亦如之。

translations.literal: The Zhongdu Directorate of Education was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongdu Directorate of Education followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以宋訥為祭酒，敕諭之曰：「太學天下賢關，禮義所由出，人材所由興。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Song Ne was appointed Chancellor; an imperial instruction said: "The Grand Academy is the noble barrier of the empire, whence ritual and righteousness issue forth and talent is raised.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Song Ne was appointed Chancellor; an imperial instruction said: "The Grand Academy is the noble barrier of the empire, whence ritual and righteousness issue forth and talent is raised.

sentences.zh: 卿夙學耆德，故特命為祭酒。

translations.literal: You have long studied and are of venerable virtue, therefore you are especially appointed Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: You have long studied and are of venerable virtue, therefore you are especially appointed Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 尚體朕立教之意，俾諸生有成，士習丕變，國家其有賴焉。」

translations.literal: Uphold my intent in establishing teaching, so that the students may succeed, scholarly custom greatly change, and the state may rely upon it."
translations.idiomatic: Uphold my intent in establishing teaching, so that the students may succeed, scholarly custom greatly change, and the state may rely upon it."

sentences.zh: 又命曹國公李文忠領監事，車駕時幸。

translations.literal: Also ordered Duke of Cao Guo Li Wenzhong to oversee directorate affairs; the imperial carriage visited from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Cao Guo Li Wenzhong was also ordered to oversee directorate affairs, and the emperor visited from time to time.

sentences.zh: 以故監官不得中廳而坐，中門而行。

translations.literal: Therefore directorate officials could not sit in the central hall or pass through the central gate.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore directorate officials could not sit in the central hall or pass through the central gate.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，更定國子監品秩、員數。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year ranks and numbers of the Directorate of Education were redefined.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year ranks and numbers of the Directorate of Education were redefined.

sentences.zh: 俱如前所列。

translations.literal: All as listed above.
translations.idiomatic: All as listed above.

sentences.zh: 中都國子監設祭酒、司業、監丞、典簿、博士、學正、學錄、掌饌各一人，助教二人，品秩與在京同。

translations.literal: The Zhongdu Directorate of Education had one each of Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, supervisor, registrar, doctor, director of study, registrar, and food administrator; two assistant instructors; ranks the same as in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongdu Directorate had one each of Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, supervisor, registrar, doctor, director of study, registrar, and food administrator, and two assistant instructors, with ranks the same as in the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，罷中都國子監。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Zhongdu Directorate of Education was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the Zhongdu Directorate of Education was abolished.

sentences.zh: 建文中，升監丞為堂上官，革學正、學錄。

translations.literal: Under Jianwen, the supervisor was promoted to hall official rank; directors of study and registrars abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jianwen, the supervisor was promoted to hall official rank and directors of study and registrars were abolished.

sentences.zh: 成祖復舊制。

translations.literal: Chengzu restored the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzu restored the old system.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，置國子監於北京，設祭酒、司業、監丞、典簿、博士、學正、學錄、掌饌各一人，助教二人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle, the Directorate of Education was established at Beijing with one each of Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, supervisor, registrar, doctor, director of study, registrar, and food administrator, and two assistant instructors.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongle, the Directorate of Education was established at Beijing with one each of Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, supervisor, registrar, doctor, director of study, registrar, and food administrator, and two assistant instructors.

sentences.zh: 後增設不常，助教至十五人，學正至十一人，學錄至七人。

translations.literal: Later additions were irregular; assistant instructors reached fifteen, directors of study eleven, and registrars seven.
translations.idiomatic: Later additions were irregular; assistant instructors reached fifteen, directors of study eleven, and registrars seven.

sentences.zh: 後革助教二人，學正四人，學錄二人。

translations.literal: Later two assistant instructors, four directors of study, and two registrars were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later two assistant instructors, four directors of study, and two registrars were abolished.

sentences.zh: 萬曆九年，又革助教四人，學錄一人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Wanli, four assistant instructors and one registrar were again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Wanli, four assistant instructors and one registrar were again abolished.

sentences.zh: 宣德九年，省司業。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xuande the Vice Chancellor was eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Xuande the Vice Chancellor was eliminated.

sentences.zh: 弘治十五年復設。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongzhi it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongzhi it was restored.

sentences.zh: 明初，祭酒、司業，擇有學行者任之，後皆由翰林院官遷轉。

translations.literal: In early Ming, Chancellor and Vice Chancellor were chosen from men of learning and conduct; later all were transferred from Hanlin Academy posts.
translations.idiomatic: In early Ming, Chancellor and Vice Chancellor were chosen from men of learning and conduct; later all were transferred from Hanlin Academy posts.

sentences.zh: 衍聖公 附五經博士

translations.literal: Duke Yansheng; appended: Doctors of the Five Classics
translations.idiomatic: Duke Yansheng; with appended section on Doctors of the Five Classics

sentences.zh: 衍聖公，孔氏世襲，正二品。

translations.literal: Duke Yansheng, hereditary in the Kong clan, rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Yansheng, hereditary in the Kong clan, rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 袍帶、誥命、朝班一品。

translations.literal: Robes, belts, patents, and court precedence of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: Robes, belts, patents, and court precedence of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年授孔子五十六代孫希學襲封。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu the fifty-sixth-generation descendant of Confucius Xi Xue was granted the hereditary seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu the fifty-sixth-generation descendant of Confucius, Xi Xue, was granted the hereditary title.

sentences.zh: 其屬，掌書、典籍、司樂、知印、奏差、書寫各一人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: one each of secretary, archivist, director of music, seal keeper, memorial bearer, and copyist.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates: one each of secretary, archivist, director of music, seal keeper, memorial bearer, and copyist.

sentences.zh: 皆以流官充之。

translations.literal: All were filled by regular-route officials.
translations.idiomatic: All were filled by regular-route officials.

sentences.zh: 曲阜知縣，孔氏世職。

translations.literal: Magistrate of Qufu, hereditary Kong clan office.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate of Qufu, a hereditary Kong clan office.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年授孔子裔孫希大為曲阜世襲知縣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu Confucius's descendant Xi Da was granted hereditary magistrate of Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu Confucius's descendant Xi Da was granted hereditary magistrate of Qufu.

sentences.zh: 翰林院世襲《五經》博士，正八品孔氏二人，正德元年授孔子五十九世孫彥繩主衢州廟祀。

translations.literal: Hereditary Hanlin doctors of the Five Classics, 8b; two in the Kong clan — in the first year of Zhengde the fifty-ninth-generation descendant Yan Sheng was appointed to preside over Quzhou temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary Hanlin doctors of the Five Classics at rank 8b: two in the Kong clan — in the first year of Zhengde the fifty-ninth-generation descendant Yan Sheng was appointed to preside over sacrifices at the Quzhou temple.

sentences.zh: 宋孔端友從高宗南渡，家於衢州，此孔氏南宗也。

translations.literal: Song Kong Duanyou followed Gaozong south; the family settled at Quzhou — this is the southern lineage of Kong.
translations.idiomatic: Song Kong Duanyou followed Gaozong south; the family settled at Quzhou — the southern lineage of Kong.

sentences.zh: 正德二年，授孔聞禮奉子思廟祀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde Kong Wenli was appointed to preside at Zisi temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengde Kong Wenli was appointed to preside over sacrifices at the Zisi temple.

sentences.zh: 顏氏一人，景泰三年，授顏子五十九世孫希惠。

translations.literal: One Yan clan — third year of Jingtai, the fifty-ninth-generation descendant of Yanzi Xi Hui.
translations.idiomatic: One Yan clan — in the third year of Jingtai, the fifty-ninth-generation descendant of Yanzi, Xi Hui.

sentences.zh: 曾氏一人，嘉靖十八年，授曾子六十代孫質粹。

translations.literal: One Zeng clan — eighteenth year of Jiajing, the sixtieth-generation descendant of Zengzi Zhi Cui.
translations.idiomatic: One Zeng clan — in the eighteenth year of Jiajing, the sixtieth-generation descendant of Zengzi, Zhi Cui.

sentences.zh: 仲氏一人，萬曆十五年，授子路裔孫仲呂。

translations.literal: One Zhong clan — fifteenth year of Wanli, descendant of Zi Lu Zhong Lü.
translations.idiomatic: One Zhong clan — in the fifteenth year of Wanli, descendant of Zi Lu, Zhong Lü.

sentences.zh: 孟氏一人，景泰三年，授孟子裔孫希文。

translations.literal: One Meng clan — third year of Jingtai, Mencius's descendant Xi Wen.
translations.idiomatic: One Meng clan — in the third year of Jingtai, Mencius's descendant Xi Wen.

sentences.zh: 周氏一人，景泰七年，授先儒周敦頤裔孫冕。

translations.literal: One Zhou clan — seventh year of Jingtai, early Ru Zhou Dunyi's descendant Mian.
translations.idiomatic: One Zhou clan — in the seventh year of Jingtai, early Ru Zhou Dunyi's descendant Mian.

sentences.zh: 程氏二人，景泰六年，授先儒程頤裔孫克仁。

translations.literal: Two Cheng clan — sixth year of Jingtai, early Ru Cheng Yi's descendant Ke Ren.
translations.idiomatic: Two Cheng clan — in the sixth year of Jingtai, early Ru Cheng Yi's descendant Ke Ren.

sentences.zh: 崇禎三年，授先儒程顥裔孫接道。

translations.literal: Third year of Chongzhen, early Ru Cheng Hao's descendant Jie Dao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongzhen, early Ru Cheng Hao's descendant Jie Dao.

sentences.zh: 邵氏一人，崇禎三年，授先儒邵雍裔孫繼祖。

translations.literal: One Shao clan — third year of Chongzhen, early Ru Shao Yong's descendant Ji Zu.
translations.idiomatic: One Shao clan — in the third year of Chongzhen, early Ru Shao Yong's descendant Ji Zu.

sentences.zh: 張氏一人，天啟二年，以先儒張載裔孫文運為博士。

translations.literal: One Zhang clan — second year of Tianqi, early Ru Zhang Zai's descendant Wen Yun as doctor.
translations.idiomatic: One Zhang clan — in the second year of Tianqi, early Ru Zhang Zai's descendant Wen Yun as doctor.

sentences.zh: 硃氏二人，景泰六年，授先儒硃熹裔孫梴。

translations.literal: Two Zhu clan — sixth year of Jingtai, early Ru Zhu Xi's descendant Ting.
translations.idiomatic: Two Zhu clan — in the sixth year of Jingtai, early Ru Zhu Xi's descendant Ting.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年又授墅為博士，主婺源廟祀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing Shu was again appointed Doctor and directed the temple sacrifices at Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 2 Shu was again appointed Doctor to oversee temple sacrifices at Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 劉氏一人，景泰七年，授誠意伯劉基七世孫祿，後革。

translations.literal: For the Liu clan one post: in the seventh year of Jingtai the seventh-generation descendant of Earl of Cheng Yi Liu Ji, Lu, was appointed; later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: One post for the Liu clan: in Jingtai year 7 Lu, seventh-generation descendant of Earl of Cheng Yi Liu Ji, was appointed; the post was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 教授司，教授，從九品學錄、學司，並未入流孔、顏、曾、孟四氏，各一人。

translations.literal: The Instruction Office: one Instructor at rank 9b, one Registrar and one Instruction Clerk, all outside the regular ranks; for the four clans of Kong, Yan, Zeng, and Meng, one each.
translations.idiomatic: The Instruction Office had one Instructor at rank 9b, a Registrar and Instruction Clerk outside the regular ranks, and one instructor each for the Kong, Yan, Zeng, and Meng clans.

sentences.zh: 又尼山、洙泗二書院，各學錄一人。

translations.literal: Further, at the Ni Mountain and Zhusi two academies, one Registrar each.
translations.idiomatic: The Ni Mountain and Zhusi academies each had one Registrar.

sentences.zh: 先是，元代封孔子後裔為衍聖公，賜三品印。

translations.literal: Previously, under the Yuan dynasty Confucius's descendant was enfeoffed as Duke Yansheng and granted a seal of rank 3.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan, Confucius's descendant was enfeoffed as Duke Yansheng with a rank-3 seal.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，太祖既以孔希學襲封衍聖公，因謂禮臣曰：「孔子萬世帝王之師，待其後嗣，秩止三品，弗稱褒崇，其授希學秩二品，賜以銀印。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, after the Taizu had Kong Xixue succeed as Duke Yansheng, he told the ritual officials: "Confucius is teacher to ten thousand generations of emperors; to treat his descendant at only rank 3 does not match such honor and elevation—grant Xixue rank 2 and bestow a silver seal."
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1, after enfeoffing Kong Xixue as Duke Yansheng, the Taizu told ritual officials: "Confucius is teacher to emperors through the ages; rank 3 for his heir does not match such honor—grant Xixue rank 2 and a silver seal."

sentences.zh: 又命復孔、顏、孟三家子孫徭役。

translations.literal: He also ordered restoration of corvée exemption for descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans.
translations.idiomatic: He also restored corvée exemption for descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans.

sentences.zh: 十八年，敕工部詢問，凡有聖賢子孫以罪輸作者，釋之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year an edict ordered the Ministry of Works to inquire: all descendants of sages and worthies sentenced to labor service for crimes were to be released.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 an edict ordered the Ministry of Works to release any sage descendants sentenced to labor for crimes.

sentences.zh: 永樂二十二年，賜衍聖公宅於京師，加一品金織衣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Yongle a residence in the capital was granted to the Duke Yansheng, with the addition of rank-1 gold-brocade robes.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 22 the Duke Yansheng received a capital residence and rank-1 gold-brocade robes.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，詔免凡聖賢子孫差役，選周、程、張、硃諸儒子孫聰明俊秀可教養者，不拘名數，送所在儒學讀書，仍給廩饌。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong an edict exempted all descendants of sages and worthies from labor service; among descendants of the Ru masters Zhou, Cheng, Zhang, and Zhu, those bright and promising and fit for nurture were selected without quota limit, sent to local Confucian schools to study, and still given grain stipends.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 1 an edict exempted all sage descendants from labor service and selected bright descendants of Zhou, Cheng, Zhang, and Zhu for local Confucian schools without quota, with grain stipends.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，給孔、顏、孟三氏學印，令三年貢有學行者一人，入國子監。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua seals were granted to the Kong, Yan, and Meng clan schools, with one person of learning and conduct to be presented every three years for entry into the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 1 the Kong, Yan, and Meng clan schools received seals; every three years one student of proven learning was presented to the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 六年，命衍聖公始襲者在監讀書一年。

translations.literal: In the sixth year it was ordered that whoever first succeeded as Duke Yansheng should study one year in the Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 each new Duke Yansheng was required to study one year at the Directorate of Education.
